pr_body: # Objective Fixes #13479 This also fixes the gaps you can sometimes observe in outlines (screenshot from main, not this PR): The outline around the last item in each section has vertical gaps. ## Solution Draw the outlines with corner radius using the existing border rendering for uinodes. The outline radius is very simple to calculate. We just take the computed border radius of the node, and if it's greater than zero, add it to the distance from the edge of the node to the outer edge of the node's outline. --- ## Showcase

issue_context.title: Bevy_ui outlines should respect BorderRadius.
issue_context.body: Not a huge priority, but it would be more visually consistent if the outlines also had rounded corners like the entity being outlined. Given that the infrastructure for rounded corners is already in place, I don't imagine that this would be too difficult, and in fact would be simpler because outlines are monocolored, and don't need to handle the alpha-blending between background color and border color.
